Really Raikou & Entirely Entei (Part 1) (Japanese: VS ライコウ そして エンテイ (パート1) VS Raikou and Entei (Part 1)), titled Raikou & Entei (Part 1) in the Chuang Yi translation, is the 137th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 47th chapter of the .

==Plot==
 
In the outskirts of Violet City, Falkner is training with his and . Suddenly, a arrives and asks him if he recently saw any rare Pokémon, to which he shows him a bountiful amount of captured Pokémon. As Falkner is about to grab his police badge to arrest him they are caught in a storm as a lightning bolt burns down a tree. A Pokémon is then seen standing on top of it. Falkner immediately realizes that it is the Legendary Pokémon while at the same time the Bird Keeper notices another one has arrived; it is the Legendary Pokémon .

The Bird Keeper then attempts to catch Entei, but Falkner, seeing the error in this folly move, quickly uses Skarmory to rescue him from Entei's attack. Raikou and Entei then look at each other and decide to test Falkner. He decides to use , but it is quickly evaded by the two . Raikou uses and then Entei uses . Falkner quickly comes up with a cunning strategy of using just as the Raikou and Entei are about to use an attack. This causes Raikou and Entei to hit each other just as Falkner escapes. Right when he is about to throw the Great Balls to catch them, a appears behind him.
